notes: Adds a global Archived Items page for archived firearms and accessories with restore and permanent-delete controls.
Makes Allow Permanent Deletion expose Delete Permanently directly on firearm and accessory detail actions as well as in the archive center.
Expands Guided Firearm Setup into a full six-step journey covering manufacturer, model, serial, type, caliber, ownership, storage, photos, magazines, compatibility and other gear.
Allows switching between Manual and Guided firearm setup without losing entered values; both modes write the same firearm record.
